problem: Portal selected-game events can still enqueue newly registered catalog IDs while their game contexts disable external collection pending Worker registration.
expected: New game021 through game025 do not send external events while their Worker registration is pending, including Portal events that encode them as envelope.game_id.
observed: TelemetryService option remoteCollectionEnabled false is checked on the current context by AnalyticsRuntime.record.
Portal creates TelemetryService without that option and emits game_card_impression, game_card_click and game_launch with selected_game.
AnalyticsRuntime.send uses selected_game as envelope.game_id for Portal events.
unknown: No compiled browser enqueue or production HTTP response was measured for the new IDs.
